name: edunet-analyzer-workspace
description: University E-Learning Network Performance Analyzer (NS-2 Simulation, Trace Analysis, and Protocol Visualization)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); }"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'frontend/dist'].forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true}); });"
